evidence: Touches CMakeLists.txt, depends/Makefile, and CI configuration scripts to bump the project C++ standard from C++20 to C++23 and raise minimum compiler versions.
rationale: Upgrading the compiler baseline to C++23 is a strategic toolchain transition that retires accumulating compatibility workarounds and unblocks future work such as #34979. As noted in the description, avoiding C++23 has required ongoing workarounds while dependencies like libmultiprocess have already begun adopting C++23 syntax.
